text:
Alina: quick sync after the ship. two signals: (1) a measurable tail-latency regression on multi-turn sessions during peak, (2) a set of ~9 small product follow-ons from pilots. do we do a single blended squad or separate hotfix squad + async polish?

Raj: need the numbers to decide. if tail latency impacts commercial pilots we should treat as hotfix first. can you paste what you saw?

Alina: numbers: staging p99 for 8k token sessions moved from ~480ms -> ~980ms under sustained load; p95 up ~200ms. no client-visible errors yet but retries and customer tickets spiked. pilots called out onboarding copy + two UI tweaks as blockers to expansion.

Mei: bugs-first. runtime debugging is high-context; polish will slow momentum. we can commit owners to polish items but not full-time.

Connor: agree w/Mei. also propose a 2-phase cadence: Phase 1 (3 days) = mitigation + canary with strict acceptance; Phase 2 (5 days) = follow-up runtime improvement if Phase 1 not sufficient, and small polish lane runs in parallel asynchronously.

ops-bot: Canary pool availability check: pool-small (2 GPUs, 6h), pool-medium (4 GPUs, 12h). Please request reservation when ready.

Raj: acceptance criteria suggestion for Phase 1: p99 <=650ms for 8k tokens under perf harness for 2h steady OR retry rate <0.4% for 4h. polish acceptance: close >=60% of low-effort items or mark them scheduled with owners and ETA.

Alina: mitigation plan: server-side pacing guard + conservative batching clamp. quick patch estimate: 2 engineer-days + 1 day ops canary + QA windows. deeper runtime fix estimate: 5 engineer-days. polish estimate: 9 items, ~5 dev-days if done by part-timers.

Connor: operational gating: let's use a canary ramp with explicit gate thresholds. pinning plan here:
```
canary ramp plan
1. reserve pool-medium for canary (4 GPUs, 12h)
2. deploy pacing_guard=true to canary
3. route 3% traffic for 1h
4. run perf-harness: ./perf/long_chat --tokens 8000 --qps 35 --duration 60
5. gate: if p99 <=650ms and retry_rate <=0.4% for 45m -> increase to 20% for 3h
6. if stable -> roll to 100% with 2h monitoring window
7. failure: rollback and enable conservative fallback (batch_clamp=128)
```

ops-bot: Reservation created: rsv-3098, pool-medium, window tomorrow 06:00-18:00 UTC. Canary ticket: canary-3098. Alerts to #eng-oncall.

Mei: freeze policy: block merges touching serving-runtime and routing until Phase 1 canary completes. allow docs and UI polish PRs (label:postlaunch-polish) to continue.

Raj: comms to pilots: recommend short proactive message: "We're deploying a targeted mitigation this week to address tail latency in long sessions. Expect minimal disruption; we'll follow up with UX improvements next week." keep promises measured. sales-bot will push to sales.

sales-bot: Draft sent to sales: "We have an actionable remediation plan and a canary scheduled tomorrow. We'll confirm metrics after canary and provide ETA for broader rollout." Legal/Sales looped.

Connor: QA plan: allocate two focused windows during canary (start + mid-run) and a 30m smoke after roll. QA to run synthetic multi-turn scenarios and verify p99/p95 and retries per-customer. I'll coordinate.

Alina: decision: spin up hotfix-squad (Raj lead + 2 runtime engs) for Phase 1; create async-polish lane (Mei lead, 2 part-timers). freeze serving-runtime merges except hotfixes for the micro-cycle. ops to run canary rsv-3098. I'll update roadmap and tell sales we expect a micro-release by end of next week if green.

Mei: I'll post the polish checklist in the sprint card and tag low-effort items with PR templates to speed reviews. avoid touching runtime in those PRs.

Raj: I'll open the mitigation PR and tag it with label:hotfix and this thread_ts for traceability. planning to have a PR up within 6h.

Connor: pinned canary commands below for eng-oncall reference:
```
# sample canary commands
kubectl set env deploy/serving --env=pacing_guard=true -n canary
./tools/loadgen --scenario long_chat --tokens 8000 --qps 35 --duration 3600
./scripts/collect_metrics --metrics p95,p99,retries --out /tmp/canary-metrics.json
```

ops-bot: Canary scheduled and alerts set. Notifications will go to #eng-oncall and #product.

Alina: if canary fails, fallback plan: enable batch_clamp=128 and revert runtime change. postmortem trigger if p99 >1s or retries >1% for >6h.

Mei: ok. I'll coordinate async polish owners and make sure sales has the list of landed items to communicate.

Raj: starting triage now; will post profiling artifacts in #eng-runtime. check-in in 3h. :rocket:
